ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 80% low-intensity (dark) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-gray/black central region (x: 200-800). Large, irregular, high-intensity white mottling clusters at the left distal tip (x: 0-200, y: 50-300) and right distal tip (x: 800-1000, y: 100-350).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 45-degree angle at the central vertex dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; visible peaks and valleys distinct against water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of small, circular white pixel clusters scattered across the dark central region; distinct cluster of two high-intensity circular nodes at the extreme right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-contrast white linear streaks; prominent vertical/diagonal rake marks visible on the right lobe (mid-section) and horizontal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (likely predatory or social interaction) visible on the right lobe surface; significant white scarring/pitting on the distal edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, raised white circular nodules at the far right upper corner of the fluke tip.
